reason: I already take Toplux and just reorder it when it runs out, and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles from trying other stuff. I'm not adding another one at $29.99 when what I have costs less.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I don't see why I'd pay more for something new.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay now, like $19 or $20 a box, and a real reason it works better than what I already take.
